title: Changes
intro: Committed code changes, grouped by the capabilities recorded in this folder.
timezone: Dates use {timezone}; both selected dates are included.
invalidRange: Choose valid dates with the start on or before the end.
noVault: Open a folder to see the commit history of its code folder.
noProject: This folder has no project to show commit history for.
sourceUnavailable: Cannot read the connected code folder. Check its connection and folder permission, then try again.
noSource: No code folder is connected to this ontology folder. Choose a Git repository and its commits appear grouped by capability.
sourceUngranted: Atlas has no permission to read the connected code folder. Choose the same folder again to grant it.
noHistory: This repository has no commits to read.
readError: Could not read the commit history. Your dates are kept; try again.
stale: The repository changed while it was being read. Refresh to read it again.
empty: No commits found in this period.
emptyHint: Choose another period or refresh after new commits.
head: Read at {hash}
scope: Commits on the branch your work merges into (first-parent). Commits inside merged branches are not counted separately. Uncommitted changes are excluded.
coverage: {mapped} files linked to a capability · {unmapped} not linked
partial: Only part of this period was read. Narrow the dates to see all of it.
limit: Read limits: {limit} commits · 8 MiB of output · 20,000 file paths. Totals count only what was read.
unmappedHint: These files match no code location recorded in this folder, so the behavior they change is unknown.
groupingNote: Grouped by the code locations recorded now. This does not show how a capability behaved in the past.
selectGroup: Choose a capability to see its changed files and commits.
commitAttribution: Written by the commit authors; Atlas has not checked what they claim.
comparisonNote: Compares the two commits shown. If commit dates are out of order, commits outside the selected dates can be included.
netEmpty: No files differ between these commits. Files may have been changed and reverted during the period.
netUnavailable: Could not compare start and end. Changed files and commit messages are still available.
patchLoading: Reading the diff for this file…
patchTruncated: Showing the first 32 KiB only. This is not the full diff.
patchBinary: This is a binary file, so there is no line-by-line diff.
patchUnavailable: Could not read this file's diff. The file list and commit messages are still available.
patchNoDifference: This file is the same in both commits. It may have been changed and reverted during the period.
patchSelect: Choose a file to see its diff here.
sourceAreaNote: Grouped by folder path, not by capability. These files are not linked to a capability.
allUnmapped: All changes not linked to a capability
comparisonScope: Compares the whole repository, whichever group is selected.
overviewTitle: Start where the most files changed
overviewHint: Choose one to see its changed files. Many changed files does not mean behavior changed.
sourceAreasHeading: Folders not linked to a capability
areasShown: Showing the {count} folders with the most files. The rest are under all changes not linked to a capability.
noMatchingFiles: No matching files. Change or clear the search.
